cases.assertion: all eight confirmed failure classes and all eight public stable error codes serialize and round-trip through their exact closed representations; only the four transient/rate classes auto-retry

approved zero-padded ChaCha20 seed expansion and one next_u64 draw per ascending attempt match exact multi-attempt full-jitter golden vectors, with exponential cap and monotonic clock rollback handling
the 14 decoded seed bytes occupy the leading bytes of the 32-byte ChaCha20 seed with 18 trailing zero bytes, then exactly one next_u64 draw is consumed for each ascending attempt
restart preserves persisted attempts and same deterministic fingerprint cannot hot-loop
length-framed SHA-256 fingerprint consumes only closed nonsecret context and emits no raw context or epoch
integrity, ownership_lost, configuration, and unsupported classes require their typed stronger proof
stale completion identity cannot clear a current failure
synthetic typed domain hook accepts expected close only for matching run_id and connection generation
prepared operations execute only through a supplied transaction, survive reopen, validate exact boundary-plus-fingerprint identity, and preserve destination current_failure_id
retry fires exactly at its persisted boundary and a cleared same-fingerprint recurrence re-arms with a higher attempt
delayed non-transient re-arm is revision-CAS persisted; automatic re-arm and stale store/link/clear operations fail closed
the shared m1.1 bounded TransitionSystem harness replays production transitions byte-identically under the fixed seed

observe, explicit and automatic re-arm, configuration proof, stale completion, restart, expiry, cancel, and persistence-CAS projections use production transitions under bounded deterministic harness schedules
bounded Harness schedules execute production observe, re-arm, clear, and supplied-transaction SQLite CAS projections

confirmed_literals.jitter_rng: ChaCha20 in tests; OS CSPRNG in production

jitter_seed_expansion.rule: decoded bytes copied at offset 0; remaining trailing bytes zero-filled

confirmed_literals.jitter_draw_order: one ChaCha20Rng::next_u64 draw per attempt in ascending attempt order before inclusive modulo
